title: Low and Wide
intro: Hips and groin, which is what tennis and padel punish most. Every wide ball, every open-stance forehand and every lunge to the net is an adductor at length under load.

This trains that range rather than hoping you have it when the ball arrives. The Cossack squat in the middle is the closest thing in a gym to a wide defensive ball, and it is the position a groin tears in if you are not strong there.

before.label: Who it's for
before.text: A groin that's tight, not one that's strained.

before.label: Stop and get it looked at
before.text: If you've strained your groin in the last couple of months, it grabs when you push off, you have pain at the pubic bone or low in the belly, or you feel a lump or bulge in the groin. Also a sharp pinch at the front of the hip in the deep positions that keeps happening.

before.label: While you train
before.text: Tired or a bit sore is fine. Sharp, in one spot, or worse first thing in the morning means back off and get it looked at.

exercises.name: Cossack Squat
exercises.note: Go only as deep as you can come back up from without a wobble.
